name: nebesny-prestol
description: Небесный Престол — фэнтези idle-RPG для Android, iOS и браузера

scripts.test: node scripts/build.mjs && npm run check && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/security-test.mjs
scripts.native: node scripts/build.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --iconBackgroundColor "#05081a" --iconBackgroundColorDark "#05081a" --splashBackgroundColor "#05081a" --splashBackgroundColorDark "#05081a" && node scripts/native-config.mjs && cap sync
scripts.android:init: node scripts/build.mjs && cap add android && npm run native
scripts.ios:init: node scripts/build.mjs && cap add ios && npm run native
scripts.sync: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/native-config.mjs && cap sync
